posts.title: Writing & Editing Stack
posts.description: Being a technical writer, I like to keep my workflows as simple as possible, with the least amount of tools necessary to complete a piece. I'm both writing and editing technical content on a daily basis, so here are some tools that help me spare a bit of brain power. Writing For writing, I use Markdown as the markup language of choice. Simple for getting the job done. Occasionally, I might use MDX

posts.title: The Manifesto
posts.description: Work in progress This plain white blog might not be much. And that is very intentional. I've created too many flashing landing pages with tons of animations and all of that shit in the past. A lot of portfolios follow a futuristic, or Apple-like, style. This one is purposefully simple. Easy on the eyes. Easy to navigate. Hopefully, with not too much clutter. Content I strive to create human-first
